lines.zh: 我喷一口水，往后倒着游。
lines.en: I squirt water and glide backwards.

lines.zh: 壳转了个方向，我跟着漂。
lines.en: The shell turns, and I drift with it.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底滑过去，几乎不扬沙。
lines.en: I skim the sand without raising a cloud.

lines.zh: 触手先探路，壳随后才到。
lines.en: Tentacles scout ahead; the shell follows.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转着圈，像一枚会走的漩涡。
lines.en: I turn slowly, a walking whirlpool.
My ammonite chambers rise and sink.
I sink a little deeper.

lines.zh: 礁石缝里能过，我先钻过去。
lines.en: There is a gap in the reef; I slip through it.

lines.zh: 我在水里翻滚，壳面反着光。
lines.en: I roll in the water, shell catching the light.
I swim slowly; the shell is heavy.
A shoal of small fish streaks past my shell.

lines.zh: 我斜着上升，去找亮一点的水。
lines.en: I rise at an angle toward brighter water.

lines.zh: 海水从壳口灌进来，又推我出去。
lines.en: Water floods the shell mouth and pushes me on.

lines.zh: 触手拨开海草，壳跟在后面。
lines.en: Tentacles part the seagrass, and the shell follows.

lines.zh: 触手一收一放，我就前进了。
lines.en: Tentacles draw in and out, and I move.

lines.zh: 我路过一片珊瑚，慢下来看了看。
lines.en: I pass a coral head and slow to look.

lines.zh: 整片海都很安静，只有我的水声。
lines.en: The sea is quiet but for my own water.
I circle half of the sunken wreck.

lines.zh: 螺纹里灌满水，我停在礁盘上。
lines.en: Water fills my whorls; I rest on the reef flat.

lines.zh: 壳上的螺纹一圈圈，我自己也数不清。
lines.en: The whorls of my shell go round and round; I lose count.
A small fish circles my shell mouth.
I release a slow string of bubbles.

lines.zh: 光从上面漏下来，落在螺纹上。
lines.en: Light leaks down and lies on the whorls.

lines.zh: 我收紧了触手，省点力气。
lines.en: I tuck my tentacles in to save strength.

lines.zh: 海底的沙一直在轻轻移动。
lines.en: The sand below keeps shifting softly.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有东西在啃珊瑚。
lines.en: Something is nibbling coral far off.

lines.zh: 我的壳里还留着上一顿饭的味道。
lines.en: My shell still smells of my last meal.

lines.zh: 我微微倾斜，让水从壳里流过。
lines.en: I tilt slightly and let water pass through.
I have rested on this reef a long while.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，那时海面会低下来。
lines.en: I wait for dusk, when the surface drops.

lines.zh: 一只蟹从我底下横着走过。
lines.en: A crab sidles beneath me.

lines.zh: 我几乎不呼吸，水自己会来。
lines.en: I barely breathe; the water comes to me.

lines.zh: 你潜下来了，我转过来看你。
lines.en: You have dived down; I turn to see you.
Your bubbles are bigger than mine.

lines.zh: 我伸出两根触手，碰了碰水。
lines.en: I reach two tentacles out to touch the water.
There is the smell of fish about your hands.

lines.zh: 你的气泡一串串，我数着。
lines.en: Your bubbles come in strings; I count them.

lines.zh: 我的螺纹对着你，转得很慢。
lines.en: My whorls face you and turn very slowly.

lines.zh: 你要抓我，得先追上这壳。
lines.en: To catch me you must first catch this shell.

lines.zh: 你游过去的水流推得我转。
lines.en: Your wake spins me slowly around.
You swim more clumsily than the reef fish.
I know your kind, the two-legged ones.
Something knocks my shell with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，触手全收了。
lines.en: I pull in; every tentacle retracts.
It hurts; the water carries the taste.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，半天才正过来。
lines.en: I tip over and take a while to right myself.
A pale scratch marks my whorl.
I jet a confused burst of water.
My shell is creaking; that is not good.
I retreat deeper still.

lines.zh: 壳里进了水，我沉了半尺。
lines.en: Water gets inside my shell; I sink half a foot.
I settle onto the sand to recover.
That is fish, and it is fresh.
I drift toward your hand.
My tentacles are already reaching out.
One piece is enough; I do not eat much.

lines.zh: 我在壳口张了张，等你松手。
lines.en: I open at the shell mouth, waiting for you to let go.

lines.zh: 血腥味在水里散得很快。
lines.en: The smell of blood spreads fast in water.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，还是回来了。
lines.en: I circle away and come back anyway.

lines.zh: 鱼在水里，我的触手先动。
lines.en: The fish is in the water; my tentacles move first.
I am a hungry little whirlpool.
That smell reminds me of the shallows.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞到我的壳了。
lines.en: Your knee knocks against my shell.
The shell is hard; do not say I did not warn you.

lines.zh: 我打了个转，被水带偏了。
lines.en: I spin, pushed off course by the water.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，气泡乱成一片。
lines.en: We collide and the bubbles scatter.

lines.zh: 我的壳撞上珊瑚，碎了一点。
lines.en: My shell knocks the coral, and a bit chips off.
You are blocking the current; I go around.

lines.zh: 我的壳蹭到你，声音很闷。
lines.en: My shell grazes you with a dull sound.
Do not kick the sand; it clouds the water.
A bump is nothing; I have a shell.

lines.zh: 我们各游各的，别贴太近。
lines.en: Let us each swim our own way, not so close.
Another shell drifts near.
We hang side by side in the water.

lines.zh: 螺纹朝着同一个方向转。
lines.en: Our whorls turn the same way.
Our tentacles brush and overlap.
This reef is room enough for two.
We settle down onto the sand together.

lines.zh: 水流把我们推得一样远。
lines.en: The current carries us the same distance.
I swim half a circle around her.
Two shells catch the light together.
Tomorrow we will still be in these waters.
I curl a tentacle around it.
I pick up whatever sinks.
This is far harder than fish.
I drag it under my shell.
Not food; I let it go.
It is stuck between my whorls.
Fishing things out of water is my trade.
I carry it a short way.
A little heavy, but I can drag it.

lines.zh: 我把它推到你脚边的沙上。
lines.en: I push it onto the sand by your feet.

lines.zh: 有条鱼从我左边过去了。
lines.en: A fish has passed on my left.
I turn my shell mouth onto it.
That shape is not coral.
All my tentacles reach out.
I flatten down against the sand.
It has slowed; perfect.
There is a trace of blood in the water.

lines.zh: 我锁住那个晃动的影子。
lines.en: I fix on that wavering shape.
It does not know I am below.
I am ready to jet.
I track it, neither fast nor slow.

lines.zh: 它往礁石里去，我绕另一边。
lines.en: It goes into the reef; I take the other side.
My tentacles stay aimed at it.
It turns circles; so do I.
The water hides my approach.
When it pauses, I close a little more.
My shell mouth is open, waiting for it.
No rush; fish always tire.
It scrapes along the sand to escape.
I am already beneath it.
My tentacles snap shut and haul it in.
My shell mouth closes; it cannot pull free.
I ram it with the whole shell.
A small red cloud blooms in the water.
It struggles twice, then stops.
I roll the catch under my shell.
Not a big bite, but enough.

lines.zh: 螺纹一转，它就翻了过去。
lines.en: One turn of the whorl flips it over.
We churn the sand into a haze.

lines.zh: 我卷壳里，还藏着一口气。
lines.en: My coiled shell still holds one last gasp.

lines.zh: 我从深水里慢慢升上来。
lines.en: I rise slowly out of the deep.
The shell appears first, then the tentacles.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的海，比记忆里冷。
lines.en: The Triassic sea is colder than I remember.

lines.zh: 我落在一片陌生的沙上。
lines.en: I settle onto unfamiliar sand.

lines.zh: 水压变了，我的壳有点响。
lines.en: The pressure has changed; my shell creaks.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口气，全是气泡。
lines.en: I let out a breath, all bubbles.

lines.zh: 这片水里有鱼，我闻到了。
lines.en: There is fish in this water; I can smell it.
I turn once to get my bearings.
The seagrass is tall; I nearly tangle.
I squeeze out from a gap in the reef.
The light is above; I head for it.

lines.zh: 一只旋壳，独自到了新海。
lines.en: One coiled shell, alone in a new sea.

lines.zh: 热水烫过壳面，我拼命往下沉。
lines.en: Hot water scalds my shell; I dive hard.
Shell upside down, I cannot right myself.

lines.zh: 水进不了壳，可我憋得难受。
lines.en: Water cannot enter, yet I am suffocating.

lines.zh: 冲击波把我和沙一起掀开。
lines.en: The blast throws me up with the sand.
A harpoon sticks into my shell.

lines.zh: 紫色的光钻进螺纹，我动弹不得。
lines.en: Violet light seeps into my whorls and holds me still.

lines.zh: 好久没鱼了，触手都没力气。
lines.en: No fish for so long; my tentacles have no strength.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我全身一抽。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and my whole body jerks.

lines.zh: 水忽然没了，我在黑里往下掉。
lines.en: The water vanishes; I fall through black.
